landing.heroBody: Record mood, sleep, symptoms, medications, and visits in one calm place. Then turn a date range into a physician-ready summary you can actually bring to a visit.

landing.howTitle: Three calm steps from a messy week to a clearer visit.

landing.seePatternBody: Charts pull from your own entries so trends in mood, sleep, and symptoms stay easy to scan.

steps.title: Your health, clearly recorded.
steps.body: HealthTrack gives you one calm place to log every day—mood, sleep, symptoms, medications, and visits—so nothing slips through before a care appointment.

steps.title: Log the day.
steps.body: Every day starts with a short guided check-in. Rate your mood, note sleep hours, flag any symptoms or medications, and jot a quick journal note. Skip anything that doesn't apply.

steps.title: See the pattern.
steps.body: Charts pull from your own entries. Spot trends in mood, sleep, and symptom frequency across 7, 30, or 90 days—without digging through a wall of text.

steps.title: Walk into care prepared.
steps.body: When a visit is coming up, pick a date range and generate a physician-ready summary from your entries. Hand it to your doctor so the conversation starts with context.
